priorStaticUse.assessment: MSAL is behind @azure/identity credential acquisition. Producer uses createVSIX/packageCommand, not publish/getAzureCredentialAccessToken; no authorization-code flow exercised.
minimatch calls brace expansion on admitted finite patterns. No pathological nested brace input established; active version finding remains.
AJV URI resolver is in Secretlint config/schema graph; vsce supplies fixed configFileJSON/rules. No malicious external schema/URI or SSRF execution established, not a universal unreachability proof.

Constant ** enumerates explicit staging with node_modules exclusion. No AbortSignal is supplied at this call, so the documented cancellation trigger is not established here; affected range remains recorded.

vsce Secretlint uses configFileJSON and loadPackagesFromConfigDescriptor instead of loadConfig/file loading. js-yaml belongs to rc-config-loader YAML file branch, with no malicious YAML document established on this path.
README/CHANGELOG render with html:true on frozen reviewed local assets. Direct reachable builder parser; trusted input context is not proof patched or harmless.
Stage filenames are filtered against finite pinned manifest/default patterns. Arbitrary attacker-selected amplification patterns were not established.
qs.stringify constructs REST queries. Inspected local package path does not invoke Gallery REST/auth calls or supply attacker query objects; no dynamic absence proof claimed.

Cheerio imports undici for fromURL while vsce uses cheerio.load on local HTML. No fromURL/cache/WebSocket/EventSource/RetryHandler execution established on package path; known HIGH TLS/cache findings stay named.
